name: p11_evt_get_cutscene_pack_offset
summary: Reads 32-bit offset entry at slot_idx*4+0x34 from loaded cutscene sprite pack header.

name: p11_evt_find_cutscene_pack_end_slot
summary: Scans cutscene pack slot flags (+4) for 0x4000 end marker; raises SystemError('N') if none before slot 0x1a.

name: p11_npc_clear_cutscene_actor_flags
summary: Clears cutscene control bits 0x1800 in field 0x0f across all 37 NPC records at g_npc_actor_tbl_base.

name: p11_evt_reset_cutscene_icon_slots
summary: Initializes 5 pairs of cutscene portrait/icon tracking slots at g_npc_evt_cutscene_icon_slots_value to 0xffff.

name: p11_evt_decompress_rle_buffer
summary: Decompresses RLE-encoded cutscene buffer into dst using sentinel byte *src and repeat length src[3].

name: p11_evt_set_player_cutscene_lock
summary: Locks or unlocks player cutscene bits across g_player_status_flags, g_core_engine_flags0, and g_player_action_flags using g_player_interact_target.

name: p11_evt_place_script_prop_slot
summary: Places scripted prop slot slot_idx in g_npc_evt_cutscene_prop_slots_alloc_lut32 table with XYZ position and sets active bit 1.

name: p11_evt_step_player_auto_walk
summary: Drives demo pad masks g_player_pad_held/g_player_pad_edge to walk player position g_player_pos_x/g_player_pos_z to target_coord.

name: p11_npc_set_actor_visibility_flag
summary: Updates visibility/collision bits on g_npc_evt_bind_cutscene_pack_spawn_table NPC records, recursing over IDs 1..36 when npc_id is 0x2a.

name: p11_evt_dispatch_script_opcode
summary: Dispatches event script opcodes 1..0x1f through jump table g_npc_evt_dispatch_script_opcode_jtbl_ptr.

name: p11_npc_get_actor_schedule_location
summary: Reads NPC or animal map/zone IDs from g_npc_tracked_at_tile_calendar_actor_table_event_flags/g_npc_actor_schedule_location_table into script VM variables g_ovl11_script_vm_vars.

name: p11_evt_get_camera_follow_npc
summary: Returns signed 16-bit camera target NPC index stored in g_npc_evt_pan_camera_target_focus_counter.

name: p11_evt_clear_cutscene_scratch
summary: Zero-clears 0x50 bytes in the cutscene scratch buffer via memset and returns 1.

name: p11_evt_clear_scheduled_event_slot
summary: Resets 12-byte scheduled milestone record at g_npc_birthday_anniversary_flags_trigger_evt_table[slot_idx] to unscheduled defaults.

name: p11_evt_check_scheduled_date_available
summary: Checks if target (season, day) avoids festivals, birthdays, and spouse schedule conflicts at g_npc_trigger_cutscene_script_evt_scheduled_counter/g_npc_evt_scheduled_date_available_ovl_count.

name: p11_npc_clamp_property_value
summary: Clamps NPC/game property value against min/max bounds in descriptor table g_npc_clamp_property_value_table_1/g_npc_clamp_property_value_table_2.

name: p11_evt_compare_vm_values
summary: Evaluates script comparison mode cmp_op (0:>=, 1:>, 2:<=, 3:<, 4:==) between lhs and rhs.

name: p11_evt_apply_vm_arithmetic
summary: Applies arithmetic operation arith_op (0:=, 1:+=, 2:-=, 3:*=, 4:/=, 5:%=) to script VM variable pointer.

name: p11_evt_sum_shipped_items
summary: Sums all 25 shipped produce counts in g_npc_evt_sum_shipped_items_generate_value plus shipped fish count g_npc_evt_sum_shipped_items_record_cfg16.

name: p11_evt_is_worked_field_tile
summary: Returns 0 for empty/weed/stone/stump field tile IDs (0x3a..0x40, 0x167..0x175) and 1 for tilled/planted tiles.

name: p11_npc_find_top_bachelorette_candidate
summary: Finds highest-affection bachelorette index 0..4 in g_npc_find_top_bachelorette_candidate_value/g_npc_actor0_affection, returning -1 if below 500.

name: p11_evt_check_animal_birth_ready
summary: Checks barn pregnancy flag (0x200 in g_anim_barn_slot0_flags) or coop egg hatch state (0x10a in g_anim_chicken_coop_tbl) against upgrades.

name: p11_npc_calc_cardinal_facing_dir
summary: Computes 4-way cardinal direction index (0..3) from src_pos XZ toward dst_pos XZ.

name: p11_dlg_upload_portrait_sprite_vram
summary: Resolves portrait_id in g_gfx_clear_render_entity_slot_spr_table_alloc_model and uploads its texture and CLUT to VRAM via LoadImage/DrawSync into g_npc_dlg_submit_portrait_sprt_upload_state_sprite_vram.

name: p11_npc_apply_npc_schedule_overrides
summary: Copies seasonal/spouse NPC schedule overrides from g_npc_apply_schedule_overrides_value_1, g_npc_apply_schedule_overrides_value_2, g_npc_apply_schedule_overrides_count, and g_npc_apply_schedule_overrides_value_3.

name: p11_evt_copy_script_bytecode_buffer
summary: Copies 0xe10 bytes of active event script bytecode into g_npc_evt_copy_script_bytecode_dispatch_cfg and resets g_npc_evt_copy_script_bytecode_dispatch_state_pending_event.

name: p11_evt_has_active_dog_or_barn_slot
summary: Scans livestock/pet state entries starting at g_anim_shipping_pet_state_idx4 for an active slot matching slot_id.

name: p11_evt_match_season_day_window
summary: Tests whether calendar clock_ptr falls within [start_day, start_day + span_days] or matches 0x1f wildcard.

name: p11_evt_match_day_of_season_range
summary: Tests if day-of-season *(s16 *)(clock_ptr+4) falls within wrapped 30-day window [start_day, start_day + span_days].

name: p11_evt_match_packed_map_condition
summary: Checks packed 6-bit map ID ((cond_bits & 0xffff) >> 10, 0x3f wildcard) against active map *(s16 *)(g_core_event_script_ctx_pad_0x04+2).

name: p11_evt_check_player_held_item
summary: Returns true when player held item ID g_core_player_state_held_item_id equals cond_bits & 0xff.

name: p11_evt_check_season_bitmask
summary: Tests current season g_farm_calendar_clock (0..3) against season bits 0x40000000..0x08000000 in cond_mask.

name: p11_evt_check_weekday_bitmask
summary: Tests current weekday g_farm_cal_weekday (0..6) against packed weekday bits 0x04000000..0x00100000 in cond_mask.

name: p11_evt_check_weather_bitmask
summary: Tests current weather g_farm_current_weather (0..4) against weather bits in cond_mask with 0xc3800 wildcard.

name: p11_evt_eval_packed_field_bits
summary: Unpacks 5-bit condition bitfields (>>0x19, >>0x14, etc.) to evaluate packed event prerequisite ranges.

name: p11_evt_unpack_three_flag_ids
summary: Unpacks up to three 10-bit event flag IDs (0x3ff mask) from packed_flags into out_ids[0..2].

name: p11_npc_map_bachelorette_index_to_id
summary: Maps bachelorette slot index 0..4 to NPC actor ID (3, 7, 9, 0xe, or 0x14).

name: p11_npc_update_all_schedules_for_time
summary: Updates schedule slot index field [0x11] across all 37 NPCs in g_npc_actor_tbl_base for minute_of_day (skips 0x168).

name: p11_evt_init_mailbox_queues
summary: Clears all 20 inbox and pending-mail slots via g_ovl15_field_all_animal_pickup_evt_state+0x49e6/0x4a36 and resets g_npc_evt_mailbox_queues_generate_state.

name: p11_evt_enqueue_inbox_letter
summary: Appends letter (sender_id, letter_id, g_farm_cal_day) to the 20-slot mailbox g_npc_evt_advance_daily_mailbox_read_counter, shifting out oldest if full.

name: p11_evt_remove_mailbox_entry
summary: Deletes slot_idx from inbox g_npc_evt_advance_daily_mailbox_read_counter or pending mail g_npc_evt_queue_mail_notification_advance_count via memmove and clears tail slot.

name: p11_evt_add_fodder_count
summary: Adds 1, 6 (mode 2), or amount (mode 3) to fodder stock g_ui_evt_add_fodder_count_consume_counter, clamping maximum at 999.

name: p11_evt_consume_fodder_count
summary: Subtracts amount from fodder stock g_ui_evt_add_fodder_count_consume_counter if sufficient, returning 1 on success or 0.

name: p11_evt_add_chicken_feed_count
summary: Adds 1 or amount (mode 2) to chicken feed stock g_ui_evt_add_chicken_feed_consume_counter, clamping maximum at 999.

name: p11_evt_consume_chicken_feed_count
summary: Subtracts amount from chicken feed stock g_ui_evt_add_chicken_feed_consume_counter if sufficient, returning 1 on success or 0.

name: p11_evt_add_fish_food_count
summary: Adds 1 or amount (mode 1) to fish food stock g_ui_evt_add_fish_food_consume_counter, clamping maximum at 999.

name: p11_evt_consume_fish_food_count
summary: Subtracts amount from fish food stock g_ui_evt_add_fish_food_consume_counter if sufficient, returning 1 on success or 0.

name: p11_evt_add_festival_medal_count
summary: Adds 1, 10 (mode 1), or amount (mode 2) to festival medal count g_ui_evt_add_festival_medal_consume_counter, clamping maximum at 999.

name: p11_evt_consume_festival_medal_count
summary: Subtracts amount from festival medal count g_ui_evt_add_festival_medal_consume_counter if sufficient, returning 1 on success or 0.

name: p11_evt_map_item_to_shipping_bin_idx
summary: Maps shippable item_id (0x41..0x4f, 0x5d..0x5f, 0x88..0xe5) to shipping histogram index 0..0x17 or -1.

name: p11_evt_reset_daily_shipping_totals
summary: Zeroes 22 bytes at g_npc_evt_daily_shipping_totals_field_cfg8 and 10 bytes at g_npc_evt_daily_shipping_totals_flag for daily shipping/tracking counters.

name: p11_evt_commit_staged_shipped_items
summary: Flushes staged basket shipping counts g_npc_evt_stage_item_into_commit_count and revenue g_npc_evt_stage_item_into_commit_state into g_npc_evt_sum_shipped_items_generate_value (cap 999) and g_npc_show_dog_affection_msg_evt_state.

name: p11_evt_try_claim_once_flag_bit
summary: Checks bit 0x400 with bit 0x4000000 unset in g_npc_event_progress_flags, setting 0x4000000 and returning 1 once.

name: p11_evt_init_scene_prop_slot
summary: Initializes a 0x18-byte scene prop slot with type_id, item_id, XYZ position, and sets active bit 1.

name: p11_evt_clear_scene_prop_slots
summary: Clears active bit 1, item/type IDs, and XYZ fields across count consecutive 0x18-byte scene prop slots.

name: p11_evt_get_scene_prop_pose
summary: Reads XYZ position and rotation for prop_id (100/101 in g_npc_active_script_entity_ptr or 0xe8/0x122..0x124 in g_npc_evt_scene_props_map_spawn_lut32).

name: p11_evt_check_player_touch_prop_box
summary: Tests player_pos XYZ against g_npc_active_script_entity_ptr (+/-200 XZ, +/-20 Y); sets g_npc_execute_player_action_evt_tick_state = 3 and returns slot ptr on hit.

name: p11_evt_tick_active_prop_timer
summary: Decrements g_npc_execute_player_action_evt_tick_state while g_npc_active_script_entity_ptr+4 bit 0x100 is active and unpaused, clearing bit 0x100 at zero.

name: p11_evt_set_farm_props_disabled_flag
summary: Sets or clears disable bit 0x4000 across all 16 farm prop entries starting at g_npc_evt_props_disabled_flag_count_cfg.

name: p11_evt_count_enabled_farm_props
summary: Counts enabled farm prop slots (bit 0x4000 cleared) across the 16 entries at g_npc_evt_props_disabled_flag_count_cfg.

name: p11_evt_try_place_power_berry_prop
summary: Stores seasonal prop/treasure ID 0x51..0x55 in g_npc_item_pickup_carry_evt_decay_counter when g_npc_event_progress_flags bit 2 is set and slot is empty.

name: p11_evt_clear_seasonal_prop_id
summary: Clears seasonal prop/treasure ID g_npc_item_pickup_carry_evt_decay_counter back to zero.

name: p11_evt_reset_horse_prop_anchor
summary: Resets secondary prop slot at g_npc_active_script_entity_ptr+0x18 to type 1 at (-1200, 0, 2900) and updates g_npc_evt_horse_prop_anchor_primary_value.

name: p11_evt_reset_primary_prop_anchor
summary: Resets primary prop slot g_npc_active_script_entity_ptr to type 1 at (-5000, 0, 2300) and updates g_npc_evt_horse_prop_anchor_primary_value.

name: p11_evt_clear_thrown_prop_state
summary: Clears bit 0x2000000 in g_npc_event_progress_flags, clears bit 1 on g_npc_active_script_entity_ptr+0x1c, and zeroes g_gfx_hud_villager_timers_evt_value.

name: p11_evt_set_field_prop_slot_item
summary: Sets visibility bit 1 and item ID (0xe8 or 0x123) on field prop slot at g_farm_field_plot_slot_growth_stage+slot_idx*0x18+0xf0.

name: p11_evt_select_state_variant_id
summary: Selects variant item ID based on priority mask bits 0x2000, 0x0800, and 0x1000 in flags.

name: p11_evt_update_house_upgrade_prop_visibility
summary: Updates active bit 1 across 13 prop entries at g_npc_evt_house_prop_visible_upgrade_cfg using season g_farm_calendar_clock, g_farm_upgrade_flags2, and g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags.

name: p11_evt_refresh_prop_active_bits
summary: Synchronizes active bit 1 across count 0x18-byte prop entries using override flags 0x20 and 0x40.

name: p11_evt_find_prop_slot_by_id
summary: Searches count consecutive 0x18-byte prop slots at slot_base for matching item ID at +2.

name: p11_evt_apply_festival_prop_overrides
summary: Copies festival prop position overrides from g_npc_evt_apply_festival_prop_value/cc0/d60 into g_farm_field_plot_slot_flags using g_farm_weather_festival.

name: p11_evt_get_season_prop_mask
summary: Returns season bitmask (2, 4, 8, or 0x10) corresponding to current season g_farm_calendar_clock.

name: p11_evt_is_screen_pos_visible
summary: Checks if projected screen coordinates fall within padded 320x240 viewport bounds (-49..369, -49..289).

name: p11_dlg_stub_hud_hook_a
summary: No-op UI/dialogue callback stub at 0x800f6630 in overlay 11.

name: p11_dlg_stub_hud_hook_b
summary: No-op UI/dialogue callback stub at 0x800f6638 in overlay 11.

name: p11_dlg_stub_hud_hook_c
summary: No-op UI/dialogue callback stub at 0x800f6640 in overlay 11.

name: p11_dlg_stub_always_ready
summary: Dialogue/UI state probe stub returning constant 1 in overlay 11.

name: p11_dlg_clear_icon_vram_cache
summary: Clears all 72 dynamic item/icon VRAM cache slots at g_npc_dlg_clear_icon_vram_item_cfg (stride 0x22).

name: p11_dlg_clear_icon_cache_locks
summary: Clears frame-lock bytes across all 72 dynamic icon cache slots at g_npc_dlg_clear_icon_cache_lru_count.

name: p11_evt_sync_camera_to_follow_npc
summary: Syncs camera focus coordinates g_core_spawn_pos_x..a8 to the active follow NPC position when g_core_engine_flags0 bit 0x400000 is set.

name: p11_evt_find_cutscene_pack_anim_offset
summary: Finds the first cutscene pack slot without 0x3c00 mask and returns its offset via p11_evt_get_cutscene_pack_offset.

name: p11_evt_get_cutscene_pack_data_ptr
summary: Resolves payload pointer inside cutscene pack_hdr using entry count *(s16 *)(pack_hdr+2) and slot offset.

name: p11_evt_get_cutscene_pack_payload_size
summary: Computes byte size of the final cutscene pack payload block between end slot offset and next entry offset.

name: p11_evt_populate_cutscene_offset_table
summary: Extracts cutscene pack slot offsets matching flag mask 0x3c00 into g_npc_evt_populate_cutscene_offset_bind_value; raises SystemError('A', 999) on overflow.

name: p11_evt_reset_cutscene_sprites_and_props
summary: Clears 10 cutscene sprite slots ending at g_npc_evt_cutscene_sprites_props_value, clears g_npc_evt_cutscene_prop_slots_alloc_lut32 props, and sets g_npc_dlg_active_cutscene_portrait_evt_counter to 1.

name: p11_dlg_show_script_message
summary: Opens script dialogue box with weather-2 typhoon text ID remap table g_npc_dlg_show_script_message_value and saves player choice to g_ovl11_script_vm_vars.

name: p11_evt_select_location_cutscene_map
summary: Resolves conditional cutscene target map ID from g_npc_event_progress_flags progress bits, event flags, season, and festival state.

name: p11_evt_pan_camera_to_target
summary: Smoothly interpolates camera target g_core_spawn_pos_x..a8 toward target XYZ or dispatches preset camera modes via g_npc_evt_pan_camera_target_jtbl_ptr.

name: p11_evt_compare_vm_var_to_const
summary: Compares script VM variable g_ovl11_script_vm_vars[var_idx] against constant rhs_const via p11_evt_compare_vm_values.

name: p11_evt_compare_two_vm_vars
summary: Compares two script VM variables in g_ovl11_script_vm_vars using p11_evt_compare_vm_values.

name: p11_evt_update_vm_var_arithmetic
summary: Performs arithmetic operation arith_op on script VM slot g_ovl11_script_vm_vars[dst_var_idx] with immediate or VM variable operand.

name: p11_evt_control_screen_fade
summary: Starts screen fade in/out or queries fade completion via hm_poll_pad_input and unlocks player on fade mode 2.

name: p11_npc_spawn_or_warp_actor
summary: Warps or configures an NPC actor's coordinates and state in g_npc_evt_bind_cutscene_pack_spawn_table..88; recurses across IDs 1..36 when 0x2a.

name: p11_evt_advance_time_or_check_morning
summary: Checks if morning 6:00 elapsed (when target_hour==-1) or tests/advances clock g_farm_cal_hour against target time.

name: p11_evt_roll_random_and_compare
summary: Draws PRNG integer in [0, max_val) via hm_prng_next, optionally saves to g_ovl11_script_vm_vars[out_var_idx], and compares to rhs_const.

name: p11_npc_trigger_or_wait_actor_anim
summary: Starts animation anim_id on NPC slot (or player at 0x29 via g_farm_player_controller_movement_evt_count) and returns 1 when finished.

name: p11_npc_add_or_query_affection
summary: Adjusts or queries villager affection via hm_ovl11_get_villager_heart_level and stores result in g_ovl11_script_vm_vars.

name: p11_dlg_show_script_text_entry
summary: Fetches dynamic script text entry via hm_text_fetch_script_entry into g_npc_dlg_show_script_text_value and opens text prompt.

name: p11_evt_place_prop_near_npc
summary: Places g_npc_evt_cutscene_prop_slots_alloc_lut32 script prop slot_idx adjacent to NPC npc_id offset by cardinal direction dir.

name: p11_evt_check_player_held_item_category
summary: Evaluates player held item g_player_held_item against target_cat preference tier 1..7 and writes tier to g_ovl11_script_vm_vars.

name: p11_dlg_wait_choice_or_close
summary: Checks if dialogue prompt result matches expected_choice, or closes dialogue window when expected_choice is -1.

name: p11_evt_play_player_cutscene_anim
summary: Plays or cancels custom cutscene sprite animation on player struct g_npc_evt_bind_cutscene_pack_play_value with facing g_player_facing_dir.

name: p11_evt_get_or_set_event_flag
summary: Gets or sets persistent event flag flag_id via hm_event_flag_get/hm_event_flag_set depending on is_get.

name: p11_evt_is_edible_or_gift_item
summary: Checks whether item_id (or VM var) is special ID 0xa4 or a valid edible/gift item in g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr descriptor table.

name: p11_evt_consume_offered_item_check
summary: Consumes and logs offered item g_core_player_state_tool_charge against target_cat or checks g_core_scene_flags delivery flag bit 0x20.

name: p11_evt_step_bgm_volume_fade
summary: Starts a BGM volume fade in/out over frames ticks or polls active fade completion.

name: p11_npc_reset_actor_position_and_anim
summary: Zeroes velocity, target offsets, and clears active cutscene flags on g_npc_actor_position_dbg_table_page_villager..4e for NPC npc_id.

name: p11_evt_bind_cutscene_node_index
summary: Resolves active cutscene graph node inside g_npc_livestock_status_panel_evt_bind_value (0x10 stride) and stores its 1-based index into g_ovl11_script_vm_vars.

name: p11_evt_set_cutscene_node_branch_var
summary: Writes low byte of script VM variable g_ovl11_script_vm_vars[var_idx] into active cutscene node branch byte (+1).

name: p11_evt_set_festival_control_flags
summary: Configures event flags 4, 5, and 0xb0 via hm_event_flag_set for festival/cutscene control mode.

name: p11_npc_is_npc_unlocked_for_event
summary: Checks town presence prerequisite flags (0x129 for NPC 0xb, 0x25 and season!=1 for NPC 0x14) before spawning.

name: p11_evt_setup_festival_arena_spawn
summary: Computes festival arena spawn coords g_core_event_script_ctx_script_work_vars..88/g_core_spawn_pos_y from g_npc_evt_save_restore_player_setup_value..54 tables and script VM vars.

name: p11_evt_schedule_future_event_date
summary: Advances 7+ days ahead from current date g_farm_cal_year..f4 avoiding festival collisions and writes (year, season, day).

name: p11_evt_record_scheduled_milestone_date
summary: Dispatches milestone handler via g_npc_evt_record_scheduled_milestone_jtbl_ptr or stamps current calendar date into g_npc_birthday_anniversary_flags_trigger_evt_counter/g_npc_birthday_anniversary_flags_trigger_evt_table.

name: p11_npc_is_cliff_present_in_town
summary: Checks flags 0x25 and 0xc9 (plus 0x20 when include_winter_job != 0) to determine if Cliff remains in town.

name: p11_npc_get_max_villager_affection
summary: Scans all 36 villagers 1..0x24 skipping festival entries to return maximum affection value.

name: p11_npc_get_married_spouse_index
summary: Checks marriage flag 0x1b (unmarried) and spouse flags 0x1c..0x20, returning spouse index 0..4 or -1.

name: p11_evt_calc_farm_planted_percent
summary: Counts planted/worked tiles across farm field g_farm_field_grid_idx2 and optional greenhouse g_farm_greenhouse_grid_idx2, returning percentage.

name: p11_npc_calc_gift_affection_delta
summary: Looks up base gift affection delta in g_npc_gift_affection_delta_value, applies wrapping/birthday bonus, and multiplies by 5 on festivals.

name: p11_npc_match_bachelorette_marriage_cond
summary: Evaluates bachelorette marriage bitmask conditions against g_npc_trigger_cutscene_script_evt_scheduled_counter spouse ID and heart/rival status.

name: p11_npc_check_actor_affection_threshold
summary: Checks if NPC affection (or horse affection g_anim_horse_state_idx22 at 0x33) meets or falls below threshold.

name: p11_evt_check_three_dialogue_flags
summary: Unpacks three 10-bit event flags (+0xfb offset) via p11_evt_unpack_three_flag_ids and checks all match expected_state.

name: p11_evt_check_paired_recipe_flags
summary: Verifies low 10-bit flag (+200) is set and high 10-bit flag (+200) is cleared for packed recipe/event condition.

name: p11_evt_check_rival_heart_event_prereq
summary: Returns true when event flag (cond_bits & 0x3ff)+0xfb is unset and p11_evt_has_active_dog_or_barn_slot returns 0.

name: p11_npc_eval_conditional_schedule_opcode
summary: Evaluates conditional NPC schedule bytecode opcodes (0xfffc/0xfffe/0xfffb + event flags) to pick schedule offset.

name: p11_evt_queue_mail_notification
summary: Routes mail immediately to p11_evt_enqueue_inbox_letter or queues into 20-slot pending buffer g_npc_evt_queue_mail_notification_advance_count.

name: p11_npc_probe_unmarried_flag
summary: Probes bachelor/unmarried event flag 0x1b via hm_event_flag_get.

name: p11_evt_record_shipped_item
summary: Logs shipped fish/crop into g_npc_evt_sum_shipped_items_record_cfg16, g_npc_show_dog_affection_msg_evt_state revenue, and g_npc_evt_sum_shipped_items_generate_value bin counters; unlocks flag 0x5f at 200 fish.

name: p11_evt_finalize_daily_shipping_gold
summary: Commits daily shipping gold g_npc_show_dog_affection_msg_evt_state on non-festival days once per day (guard flag 0xa0) and resets accumulator.

name: p11_evt_get_shipped_item_count
summary: Returns shipped count from g_npc_evt_sum_shipped_items_generate_value for item_id via p11_evt_map_item_to_shipping_bin_idx, or -1 if invalid.

name: p11_evt_stage_item_into_basket

name: p11_evt_step_thrown_prop_physics
summary: Updates thrown/dropped prop arc physics on g_npc_active_script_entity_ptr, casts floor ray (0x800bdce8), projects camera coordinates (0x800bdb88), and settles via 0x800f4fc8/cec.

name: p11_dlg_draw_lru_item_icon
summary: Draws an item icon using LRU VRAM slot cache g_npc_dlg_clear_icon_vram_item_cfg/fd4 (preloading via 0x800f6a24 when uncached), or draws empty slot background via 0x800f7010.

name: p11_dlg_transfer_menu_grid_slot
summary: Transfers, swaps, or merges inventory items between menu grid coordinates (src_x, src_y) and (dst_x, dst_y) via 0x800f82fc, 0x800f7e38, 0x800f7fac, and 0x800f8188.

name: p11_npc_update_all_cutscene_actors
summary: Iterates all 37 NPC actor records (g_npc_actor_tbl_base/6300) when unpaused (g_core_engine_flags0 & 0x800000 == 0) and active (bits 0x18000000), calling 0x80107dec and 0x800e46a8.

name: p11_dlg_handle_storage_menu_pad_input
summary: Processes menu controller buttons (g_io_active_pad_buf_ptr+8 masks 0x10/20/40/100) to pick up, place, swap, or discard rucksack, tool, shelf, and fridge items with SFX.

name: p11_evt_step_cutscene_bytecode_vm
summary: Executes cutscene VM opcodes at g_anim_submenu_state_flag_livestock_evt_lut32 via dispatch table g_npc_evt_cutscene_bytecode_vm_dat_ptr until terminator 0xff or yield bit 1, then ticks actors, props, and camera.

name: p11_evt_spawn_or_clear_festival_chickens
summary: Spawns 4 festival chicken actors (hm_ovl11_spawn_harvest_pickup(0x109), flag 0x40000) using g_npc_evt_spawn_clear_festival_value positions, or releases entries in g_anim_chicken_coop_tbl via 0x800e2904.

name: p11_evt_spawn_or_reset_cutscene_dog
summary: Spawns the player's dog actor (ID 0x15e) for an event cutscene or resets dog state g_anim_dog_state via 0x8010b64c.

name: p11_npc_query_actor_to_vm_var
summary: Queries or picks an actor via p11_ui_run_animal_picker_dialog(target_id, 1, ...), stores the result into VM variable g_ovl11_script_vm_vars[out_var], and returns true if != -1.

name: p11_evt_sync_barn_and_coop_animals
summary: Synchronizes barn and coop animal states by invoking p11_field_deliver_newborn_animals(1) followed by p11_field_deliver_newborn_animals(0).

name: p11_npc_adjust_affection_wrapper
summary: Thin wrapper calling hm_ovl11_query_npc_affection(0, npc_id, delta_val, 0) to apply a scripted NPC affection change.

name: p11_evt_load_tool_or_item_anim_pack
summary: Loads tool/item animation pack via 0x800d6a94, 0x800d7338, and 0x800cb540 using either equipped tool g_player_equipped_tool or rucksack slot g_player_rucksack_tools.

name: p11_evt_play_held_item_anim_and_stamina
summary: Plays held item g_core_player_state_action_sub_vars_idx10 animation via 0x800d7338 and optionally applies stamina/fatigue cost via 0x800c4f44 on g_core_player_state.

name: p11_evt_eval_schedule_condition_mask
summary: Evaluates packed event condition bitmask across season (0x800f1bd0), weekday (0x800f1c48), weather (0x800f1cc4), and actor presence (0x800e6ee0).

name: p11_dlg_dispatch_hud_and_menu_ui
summary: Master overlay 11 HUD/UI tick and render dispatcher invoking 0x8002470c(0), 0x800f67e0..0x801038e4, hm_ovl11_draw_town_map_overlay, and 0x8011f5bc.

name: p11_evt_end_cutscene_and_unlock_player
summary: Terminates active cutscene: clears flag 3, refocuses camera on player (-2), unlocks player controls, clears held item g_core_player_state_held_item_id, and resets prop 0x36.

name: p11_evt_run_story_cutscene_if_valid
summary: Returns 1 immediately if table_idx == -1, otherwise executes the corresponding story cutscene entry via hm_ovl11_execute_story_cutscene_table.

name: p11_evt_grant_year_milestone_gift
summary: Awards year-milestone item/Power Berry 0x103 via hm_ovl11_query_npc_affection and 0x800e6f34, and advances stored milestone year g_npc_evt_grant_year_milestone_execute_flag.

name: p11_evt_reset_and_dispatch_cutscene_state
summary: Clears cutscene prop/sprite subsystems (0x800e4568..54c8, 0x800e5230) and toggles cutscene begin/end via 0x800dbf60 -> 0x800e5294 / 0x800e537c.

name: p11_dlg_tick_mailbox_reader_ui
summary: Drives open mailbox letter UI state g_npc_dlg_tick_mailbox_reader_evt_state_open_read/94: advances to next letter via 0x800f2724, triggers year gift 0x800f3840, or closes on button 0x20.

name: p11_evt_dispatch_pending_event_script
summary: Dispatches queued event script buffer g_npc_evt_copy_script_bytecode_dispatch_cfg via hm_ovl11_run_dialogue_choice_prompt when g_npc_evt_copy_script_bytecode_dispatch_state_1 != 0 and g_core_engine_flags1 bit 0x800 is clear.

name: p11_evt_control_or_query_target_substate
summary: Resolves target_id (optionally from VM var when from_var != 0) and executes mode 0..4 substate control (0x80107c80) or status query (0x8010734c).

name: p11_evt_check_target_substate_active
summary: Invokes 0x800e7a74(target_id, 4, 0, 0) to test whether target_id is in an active/non-idle scripted substate.

name: p11_npc_set_player_or_actor_facing
summary: Sets cardinal facing direction facing_dir on the player (g_player_facing_dir + hm_ovl11_update_player_controller) when entity_id < 0x32, or on actor g_npc_face_actor_toward_player_facing_table.

name: p11_evt_warp_and_face_player
summary: Warps player position g_player_pos_x..08 from immediate args (mode==0), VM vars (mode==1), or resets/faces via 0x800cd0c0 + 0x800e9284, updating fatigue via 0x800cb4e0.

name: p11_evt_drive_player_collapse_or_sleep
summary: Drives or polls player dizzy/collapse/special-sleep state bits in g_player_status_flags (& 0x800000/8) and g_core_player_state_target_scene_anim via 0x800cd670 and 0x800e9284.

name: p11_npc_turn_entity_toward_target_and_emote
summary: Computes facing angle from entity_id toward target_id via 0x800f06d8, applies facing via 0x800e9284 or emote via hm_ovl11_spawn_npc_emote_balloon, and unfreezes via 0x800e5c60.
